name: When should I consider widening my doorways?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider widening my doorways?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider widening your doorways if you or a family member needs improved accessibility for mobility devices like wheelchairs or walkers. It's also a valuable upgrade during a home renovation to enhance natural light, create a more open floor plan, or accommodate large furniture and appliances. Widening doorways can improve the aesthetic appeal and functionality of your home, making everyday living more comfortable and convenient.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider widening doorways for improved accessibility, during renovations to enhance open-plan aesthetics, or to accommodate large items like furniture or appliances.
